tracks.title: Sampling & distributions
tracks.summary: A short path from the shape of a normal curve, through sampling, to the chi-square, z, and t distributions used in basic tests.

steps.title: Building the Normal Distribution
steps.note: See how a normal curve is assembled before treating it as a model for data.

steps.title: Central Limit Theorem (CLT)
steps.note: Watch sample means pile into that shape as each sample gets larger.

steps.title: Horowitz (1974) CLT Simulation
steps.note: Replay Horowitz's classroom simulation of the same sampling result.

steps.title: Chi-Square Distribution
steps.note: Square standard normal draws and add them to build a chi-square curve.

steps.title: z-Distribution vs t-Distribution
steps.note: Compare the z curve with the heavier-tailed t curve used when the population standard deviation is unknown.

tracks.title: EEG basics
tracks.summary: A short path from what a scalp EEG trace is, through taking that trace apart, to the averaged event-related potential.

steps.title: EEG Illustration
steps.note: Start with what a scalp recording is measuring.

steps.title: EEG Signal Decomposition
steps.note: Take one trace apart into the rhythms that add up to the raw signal.

steps.title: Event-related potential (ERP)
steps.note: Average time-locked segments of that signal to reveal an event-related potential.
